input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Matches our preferred position: mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees (paid or payable) and USD 1,000,000; mutual consequential-damages exclusion in 21.2 with incident-response and replacement-service costs preserved as direct damages; Excluded Claims in 21.3 cover confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirm payment obligations are not damages. "Fees" (1.5) is a meaningful base of recurring, professional-services and usage fees.

input.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Vendor gives the full preferred indemnity: IP infringement (20.1) plus breach of law, bodily injury/property damage, Customer Data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud (20.2). Procedure in 20.4 is standard, 20.5 provides procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and Customer's reverse indemnity in 20.3 is narrow (unmodified Customer material and Customer's unlawful use, with Vendor Technology/modification/instruction exclusions). Indemnities also sit outside the liability cap as Excluded Claims.
